_note: RE-BASELINED 2026-08-27, P6.14: the gate now scores fuelKind and currency - the two extracted fields CorpusABScorer previously ignored. Every total below grew by the newly-asserted cells (receipts +69, pump +23, fiscal +2, screenshots +16), so the headline numbers look like a leap; they are a wider measurement, not a parser improvement, and they are the honest state of the live TankbookCore extractor on the corpus. The numeric three-field scores are UNCHANGED at their pre-P6.14 marks (receipts 48/106, pump 2/61, fiscal 1/3, screenshots 18/24) - no extractor code was touched. The new-field truth, measured live: receipts fuelKind 25/30, currency 14/39; pump fuelKind 0/0 (pump displays never claim a fuel kind - the grades belong to every nozzle, not the fill), currency 19/23; fiscal fuelKind 1/1, currency 0/1; screenshots fuelKind 3/8, currency 6/8. Two readings worth writing down so a later reader does not 'fix' them: (1) receipts currency is 14/39 because the marker-word detector needs a currency word to OCR, and most Russian receipts do not print one that Vision reads (the KZT tenge on receipt-033 OCRs as 'gg' - the P2.10 gap the gate now sees); (2) the five Circle K diesel app screenshots miss fuelKind because 'D B0 miles' is not yet normalised to diesel, while screenshot-001's RUB is absent because its crop contains no currency marker at all (receipts/README). P2.11's fix IS visible: receipt-034 now scores petrol95. Per-class accuracy: receipts 87/175 = 49.7% (was 48/106 = 45.3% - a rise, because fuelKind detection was already good), pump 21/84 = 25.0% (was 3.3%), fiscal 2/5 = 40% (was 33%), screenshots 27/40 = 67.5% (was 75% - the one percentage that FALLS while hits rose 18 -> 27, because 7 of the 16 new screenshot cells miss; the ratchet guards absolute hits, so this is correct). PumpPhotoGate was moved 2/61 -> 21/84 in the same change - it is asserted against the live score. MIND WHICH TOOL YOU SCORE WITH: these marks are the numbers the TankbookCore ratchet test measures, NOT the ones `swift run ReceiptSpike` prints - the harness's own parser disagrees. Run `cd ios && swift test --filter AccuracyRatchet` and read the numbers out of its failure message. The P4.12/P4.13 A/B arms are NOT re-baselined: their committed result files predate the two columns, so they keep scoring the three numerics only (`CorpusScorer.loadExpectedNumericsOnly`) at their pinned 46/96, 84/96, 29/96 etc.
